name: Jack Henry Symitar (Core Banking)
description: System of record for loans, member shares, 60-day delinquency by segment, and the SEG code on every account. The intelligence layer reads it overnight; it does not replace it.

name: MeridianLink
description: Loan origination, including the indirect dealer channel, with the origination date that separates recent vintages from seasoned ones.

name: General Ledger & Board Reporting
description: Net worth, the balance sheet, and the monthly board financials the ratios are measured against.

name: ALM Model (Interest-Rate Risk)
description: Interest-rate risk model. Reprices the balance sheet under parallel shocks of plus or minus 25, 50 and 100 basis points and projects quarter liquidity.

name: Investment Portfolio Accounting
description: Securities holdings and their market value, used to mark the investment portfolio under each rate shock.

name: Board Policy & ALCO Playbook Library
description: Board risk-tolerance limits, aligned delinquency parameters, the funding-review trigger, and the approved ALCO rate response playbook.

name: Greenplum on Tanzu
description: Data warehouse that joins the core, origination and ledger history so trends by segment, vintage and SEG group can be read in one place.
